The graph.json it tells:

{"$schema":"../../schemas/graph.schema.json","version":1,"title":"Signing in with OAuth","nodes":[{"id":"user","label":"User","kind":"actor","icon":"user"},{"id":"browser","label":"Browser","kind":"service","icon":"globe"},{"id":"app","label":"Web app","kind":"service","icon":"app-window","zone":"backend"},{"id":"sessions","label":"Sessions","kind":"database","icon":"database","zone":"backend"},{"id":"api","label":"Photos API","kind":"service","icon":"image","zone":"backend"},{"id":"idp","label":"Identity provider","kind":"external","icon":"shield-check"}],"edges":[{"id":"click","from":"user","to":"browser","label":"Sign in"},{"id":"login","from":"browser","to":"app","label":"GET /login"},{"id":"authorize","from":"browser","to":"idp","label":"authorize"},{"id":"code","from":"idp","to":"browser","label":"authorization code"},{"id":"callback","from":"browser","to":"app","label":"callback with code"},{"id":"exchange","from":"app","to":"idp","label":"code + client secret"},{"id":"token","from":"idp","to":"app","label":"access token"},{"id":"store","from":"app","to":"sessions","label":"save session"},{"id":"fetch","from":"app","to":"api","label":"GET /photos + token"}],"zones":[{"id":"backend","label":"Your backend"}]}

---

The current storyboard.json:

{"$schema":"../../schemas/storyboard.schema.json","version":1,"scenes":[{"id":"sign_in","title":"Sign in","nodes":["user","browser","app","idp"],"beats":[{"id":"start","caption":"A user wants to sign in.","say":"A user opens the app and clicks Sign in.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"user"},{"type":"appear","node":"browser"},{"type":"flow","edge":"click"}]},{"id":"hand_off","caption":"The app hands off to the identity provider.","say":"The app never sees the password. It sends the browser to an identity provider instead.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"app"},{"type":"flow","edge":"login"},{"type":"appear","node":"idp"},{"type":"flow","edge":"authorize"}]},{"id":"consent","caption":"The user signs in with the provider.","say":"The user signs in there, and agrees to share their photos with the app.","actions":[{"type":"callout","node":"idp","title":"One password","text":"The user signs in with an account they already have."},{"type":"highlight","node":"idp"}]},{"id":"code","caption":"The provider sends back a one-time code.","say":"The provider redirects back with a short-lived, one-time code.","actions":[{"type":"flow","edge":"code"},{"type":"badge","node":"browser","text":"code","tone":"info"}]},{"id":"callback","caption":"The browser passes the code to the app.","say":"The browser hands that code to the app.","actions":[{"type":"flow","edge":"callback"}]}]},{"id":"exchange","title":"Token exchange","nodes":["browser","app","idp","sessions","api"],"beats":[{"id":"swap","caption":"The app swaps the code for a token.","say":"Now the app talks to the provider directly, server to server, and swaps the code for a token.","actions":[{"type":"flow","edge":"exchange"},{"type":"callout","node":"app","title":"Back channel","text":"The client secret never reaches the browser."}]},{"id":"token","caption":"The provider returns an access token.","say":"The provider checks the code and the secret, and returns an access token.","actions":[{"type":"flow","edge":"token"},{"type":"badge","node":"app","text":"token","tone":"ok"}]},{"id":"session","caption":"The app starts a session.","say":"The app saves a session, so the user stays signed in.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"sessions"},{"type":"flow","edge":"store"}]},{"id":"fetch","caption":"The token unlocks the user's photos.","say":"With the token, the app can fetch the user's photos, and nothing else.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"api"},{"type":"flow","edge":"fetch"},{"type":"highlight","node":"api"}]},{"id":"done","caption":"Signed in, without sharing a password.","say":"The user is in, and their password never touched the app.","actions":[{"type":"dim","except":["browser","app","api"]}]}]}]}

---

The change the user asked for:

Shorten beat 3.

from.description: For move and copy: where from.

value.description: For add, replace and test: the value as JSON text, such as "\"Google\"" or "{\"id\": \"retry\"}".

patch.description: An RFC 6902 JSON Patch on the current file, each value written as JSON text.

summary.description: What the patch changes, in a sentence.

reply.text: {"patch":[{"op":"replace","path":"/scenes/0/beats/2/say","value":"\"The user signs in there and agrees to share their photos.\""}],"summary":"Shortens the narration for beat 3 (consent) by cutting it to one short sentence; the caption, callout and other beats are unchanged."}
